description: Holds a draft up against the team's rules and examples before a person sees it, and says which rules it breaks and why. Send the text, a public https image link, or both. Fix what it reports, then ask a person if the work still needs one. Free.

category.description: The kind of work, if you know the team's name for it. Optional and need not be exact: Plures reads the draft and applies the rules of every category it fits

image_url.description: A public https link to the image: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 4 MB

name: check_against_standards
title: Check a draft against the team's standards
